datasets.title: Sudan - GRID3 SDN - Settlement Extents v3.0
datasets.description: The GRID3 SDN - Settlement Extents v3.0 consists of a geographic representation of settlements in Sudan, in two forms: (1) settlement polygons, and (2) spatial points depicting the centroids of settled grid cells at 3-arc seconds (or ~100 meters) contained within settlement polygons. Both layers include attributes as described in the codebooks. The current version supersedes GRID3 Sudan Settlement Extents, Version 02; the following changes were made: (1) Development of a new methodology to derive building counts and settlement polygons with open data. (2) Estimation of a probability value for settlement polygons (3) Addition of a building-area measure (4) Replacement of degree of urbanization with classification based on built-up areas, small settlement areas, and hamlets (5) Elimination of building-count ranges (6) Elimination of variable comparing to previous versions Recommended Citation: Center for International Earth Science Information Network (CIESIN), Columbia University. 2024. lineage.description: Settlement extents for Sudan were derived using a new open-data methodology developed by GRID3 to generate building counts and settlement polygons. The dataset includes both polygon representations of settlements and point centroids of settled grid cells at 3-arc second (~100m) resolution, with probability values assigned to settled areas. This version (v3.0) supersedes v2.0 with an updated methodology and improved spatial accuracy.
